title: Phones With the Best Battery Life (2026)
summary: The OnePlus 15 lasts longest of any phone tested, but it is leaving the US, so iPhone Pro Max models and the Moto G are the safer buys.
method: Picks come from Tom's Guide's battery tests, CNET, BGR, GeekChamp, Mobility Arena and iTechGuides, which summarizes Tom's Guide results. Only phones named by at least two of these sources are listed.
assumptions: We show no prices because phone prices change often. Battery times come from each site's own tests and cannot be compared across sites. OnePlus is exiting the US and Europe, so the OnePlus 15 is only available while stock lasts.

products.name: OnePlus 15
why: Tom's Guide led its battery-life ranking with the OnePlus 15, and iTechGuides, summarizing those results, reports a 25 hour 13 minute test result, the longest of any phone sold in the US. CNET also names OnePlus and Apple as the brands with the longest battery life in its tests.
iTechGuides lists a 7,300mAh battery with 80W wired and 50W wireless charging.
OnePlus confirmed on July 16, 2026 that it is ending new launches in North America and Europe; remaining stock is sold and existing owners keep updates and warranty.
pros: Longest tested battery life in a US-available phone
cons: OnePlus is leaving the US and Europe, so availability is limited to remaining stock
products.best_for: People who want the longest-lasting flagship with fast charging
products.skip_if: You want a phone that will keep selling in the US, the best camera or the iPhone ecosystem
products.amazon_listing: OnePlus 15, 16GB RAM + 512GB Storage, Dual-SIM, Unlocked Android Smartphone, Snapdragon 8

products.name: Apple iPhone 17 Pro Max / 18 Pro Max
why: CNET says the iPhone 17 Pro Max has the best battery life in its tests, thanks to the efficiency of the A19 Pro chip and iOS 26 rather than a record-sized battery. Tom's Guide calls it the longest-lasting iPhone it has tested at 17 hours 54 minutes.
Trusted Reviews says the bigger iPhone 18 Pro model is still the best iPhone for battery life overall.
pros: Best battery life ever on an iPhone
products.best_for: iPhone users who want the longest battery
products.skip_if: You want the absolute longest life or the cheapest phone
products.amazon_listing: Apple iPhone 17 Pro Max, US Version, 256GB, eSIM, Deep Blue- Unlocked (Renewed)

products.name: Motorola Moto G (2026)
why: Tom's Guide ranks the Moto G (2026) as its best budget-oriented pick at 19 hours 10 minutes, with the cheaper Moto G Play (2026) close behind at 18 hours 50 minutes. BGR also lists the Moto G Play (2026) among its best battery-life phones.
CNET says models from Motorola made its top five for battery life, and nearly half its top picks use silicon-carbon batteries.
products.best_for: Budget buyers who want a phone that lasts
products.skip_if: You want flagship performance and cameras
products.amazon_listing: Motorola Moto G Power - 2026 | Unlocked | Made for US 8/128GB | 50MP Camera | Pantone Pure

products.name: Motorola Razr Ultra (2026)
why: Tom's Guide, as summarized by iTechGuides, makes the Razr Ultra (2026) the battery-life leader among foldables at 16 hours 20 minutes. Mobility Arena also notes its 5,000mAh battery is the largest among the current flip phones it covers.
iTechGuides says it uses a silicon-carbon battery.
pros: Best battery life of any flip phone
products.amazon_listing: Motorola Razr Ultra 2026 | Unlocked | Made for US 16/512GB | 50MP Camera | Pantone Cocoa
